title: Quests on the map
summary: Quests and objectives can point to places, map pins and search areas, and the map has a Quests panel.
items: DMs can tie a quest or any objective to a place, an existing map pin, or a radius area drawn on a map, for example "Harkon's horse is somewhere in here".
Draw an area, drag its centre or edge, or type its radius in the map's own units; place it off the real target if you want only a general idea.
The map's Quests tool lists the quests on that map with Show all, Only followed or None; pick one to highlight it and zoom to its pins and areas.
Players see accent diamonds and dashed circles only for what the DM shared: areas for hidden objectives, or under fog, never reach them.
Show on map in the quest log now opens the map on that quest, and Layers can hide quest markers or areas.
